entities.summary: Sant Pere de Galligants is Benedictine abbey in Girona, Catalonia, Spain. Since 1857, it is home to the Archaeology Museum of Catalonia venue in the city. The name translates to English as "Saint Peter of Galligants", where Galligants refers to the River Galligants that runs past the abbey.
